Per the legacy audits and the prior 2H paper-execution-ledger composition-root impl, paper-ledger evidence in the legacy runtime was scattered across legacy logs, ad-hoc monitor scripts, and the legacy account-history record set, with no parallel typed projection that lifts a typed PaperExecutionLedgerEntry into a single typed envelope row carrying mirrored ledger lineage IDs (paper_trade_id, risk_decision_id, decision_id, prediction_id, feature_snapshot_id), mirrored symbol, mirrored ledger_entry_ts_ms, mirrored ledger-side action / reason codes (ledger_action, ledger_reason_code), mirrored input-side risk action / reason codes (input_risk_action, input_risk_reason_code), the per-row live_blocked flag, and deterministic test-only metadata (source_scenario_slug, step_index, legacy_evidence_pointer). Phase 2S records this paper-ledger-explainability-projection gap as the second Lane B post-consolidation typed-mirror evidence-collection artifact: a deterministic four-scenario typed evidence pack (12 typed input rows) and a pure-function projection harness building the existing PaperExecutionLedgerRecorder composition root once at harness level and invoking the recorder per-row. Phase 2S does NOT introduce an explainability-rendering FastAPI route, an explainability frontend page, an explainability scheduler, an explainability background loop, an explainability persistence layer, an explainability Redis adapter, or any Binance read-only API client. Phase 2S produces typed paper-ledger explainability envelope rows that subsequent Lane B UI panel milestones consume as real backend contracts (per REQ_0009 § Required UI visibility and REQ_0018 lane B, no fake reasoning, real lineage IDs only). The richer explainability fields (top positive / negative feature contributors, feature-freshness flags, regime context, model / checkpoint version, confidence delta, calibration, position sizing reason, risk-check ledger, blocked-trade reason, paper / shadow / legacy comparison, full audit timeline) belong to separate, later milestones explicitly out of scope at Phase 2S; their underlying lineage / projection subsystems do not exist at consolidation HEAD.
